Name: OMC - OMEGAlinc's Commands
Author: OMEGAlinc
Description:
[b][center][u][size=6][/size][/u][/center][/b][left][size=6][img]https://i.ibb.co/f2TrpbL/these-are-the-current-smapi-commands.png[/img]﻿
[/size][b][u]finishbuildings[/u] (finishes all buildings under construction)
[u]growal[/u]l (grows all crops)
[u]listanimals[/u] (lists info about all your animals in the smapi console)
[u]npclocations[/u] (lists all the locations of npcs in the smapi console)
[u]petall[/u] (pets all animals)
[u]setmenukey[/u] (changes the key to open the menu, this can also be done in the config.json)
[u]skillincrease[/u] (increases a specified skill by a specified amount of points)
[u]sleepanywhere[/u] (puts the player to sleep, use at your own risk!)
[u]waterallcrops[/u] (waters all crops)[/b]



[size=5]
[/size][img]https://i.ibb.co/kxFc96g/compatibility.png[/img]﻿
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.13+.
Compatible with SMAPI 4.1.6+.




[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxxPTf9/how-to-use.png[/img]
Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
Put the OMC folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
Load Stardew Valley using SMAPI.﻿
